question: Azorius First-Wing has protection from enchantments. Does it also have protection from creatures that are enchanted?

expected.shortAnswer: No: it does not have protection from enchanted creatures.
expected.answer: Azorius First-Wing doesn’t have protection from creatures that are enchanted.
